# coolify_notification_email (Resource)

Manages the current team's email notification settings in Coolify. This is a team-scoped singleton (one configuration per team, selected by the API token). **Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0** (notification routes are absent on v4.2.x and older; acceptance tests skip when the API is missing).

Email can use SMTP, Resend, and/or instance-level settings. Coolify treats the channel as enabled when any of `smtp_enabled`, `resend_enabled`, or `use_instance_email_settings` is true.

On destroy, all three enable flags are set to `false`; credentials are left unchanged. Import with id `current`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Team email notification settings (Coolify >= v4.3.0).
# Import: terraform import coolify_notification_email.main current
resource "coolify_notification_email" "main" {
  smtp_enabled      = true
  smtp_host         = "smtp.example.com"
  smtp_port         = 587
  smtp_encryption   = "starttls"
  smtp_from_address = "alerts@example.com"
  smtp_from_name    = "Coolify"
  smtp_recipients   = "ops@example.com"
  smtp_username     = "smtp-user"
  smtp_password     = "change-me-in-production"
  # smtp_ehlo_domain needs Coolify >= v4.3.10
  # smtp_ehlo_domain = "mail.example.com"

  deployment_failure = true
  backup_failure     = true
  server_disk_usage  = true
  server_unreachable = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `backup_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for backup failure events.
- `backup_success` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for backup success events.
- `deployment_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for deployment failure events.
- `deployment_success` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for deployment success events.
- `docker_cleanup_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for Docker cleanup failure events.
- `docker_cleanup_success` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for Docker cleanup success events.
- `resend_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Resend API key. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `resend_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Resend delivery is enabled.
- `scheduled_task_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for scheduled task failure events.
- `scheduled_task_success` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for scheduled task success events.
- `server_disk_usage` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for server disk usage events.
- `server_patch` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for server patch events.
- `server_reachable` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for server reachable events.
- `server_unreachable` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for server unreachable events.
- `smtp_ehlo_domain` (String) Hostname sent with SMTP EHLO. Set a valid hostname, or omit to use Coolify's default. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.10 ([coollabsio/coolify#11398](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/pull/11398)). On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `smtp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SMTP delivery is enabled.
- `smtp_encryption` (String) SMTP encryption. One of `starttls`, `tls`, or `none`.
- `smtp_from_address` (String, Sensitive) SMTP From address. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import. Must be a valid email address.
- `smtp_from_name` (String, Sensitive) SMTP From display name. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_host` (String, Sensitive) SMTP host. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP port (1-65535).
- `smtp_recipients` (String, Sensitive) Comma-separated recipient addresses. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_timeout` (Number) SMTP timeout in seconds (>= 0).
- `smtp_username` (String, Sensitive) SMTP username. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `status_change` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for status change events.
- `traefik_outdated` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications for Traefik outdated events.
- `use_instance_email_settings` (Boolean) Whether to use the Coolify instance's shared email settings for this team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Team-scoped singleton: always import as "current".
terraform import coolify_notification_email.main current
```
